scenarios.scenario: Sign in with actual nurse credentials; verify assigned census, no access after assignment ends, and mixed nurse/hospital browser sessions.
On the commissioned tablet, create/save/sign a note, lock/unlock, amend a signed note and reconcile an interrupted save.
Enter locally approved vital vectors, verify score/completeness and demonstrate critical-alert ownership and acknowledgment.
Verify fluid totals across facility midnight, a backdated entry and a signed correction against the ward paper/downtime record.
Use actual wristband and medicine scanners; demonstrate matching dose and rejection of wrong patient, product, units, dose and route.
Demonstrate distinct witness reauthentication, signed hospital treatment consent and current-order checks for a locally approved high-alert scenario.
Reconcile given/refused/held doses with physical issue, consumption, returns and billing; verify no duplicate stock or financial movement.
Review assessment templates, care goals, reviewed wound image history, procedures and reassessment schedules.
Send and accept the actual full ward shift handover with the incoming nurse; verify transfers and census conflicts.
Verify retention/access policy, actual image upload/read, device key commissioning and device-clock behavior.
Execute deployed authentication/revocation, downtime/recovery, partner export and measured production capacity scenarios.
Approve staff training, operating procedures, incident ownership and the supervised ward pilot outcome.

instructions: Reviewers must execute scenarios under hospital governance, record results and non-PHI evidence references, and attest the release decision. Automated checks cannot populate human attestations.
